name: Crusoe Energy
summary: Crusoe Energy appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First. Argued in Part 13 (The load pays its way).

mentions.excerpt: Crusoe Energy told FERC on March 16 that co-located generation, a power plant built beside the data center it feeds, lowers ratepayer costs when it is set up correctly.

sides.claim: Crusoe states that co-located generation, when structured correctly, simultaneously advances grid reliability, reduces ratepayer costs, and accelerates AI infrastructure buildout, which is the basis of its energy-first 'bring your own power' model.
